note: Gibraltar, read on HM Government of Gibraltar's own pages on 2026-10-30. An employer must apply to the Department of Employment for a work permit before a non-EU national starts work (read as work for the sponsor; from either side of the border, since the page names no place); the fee table under the Employment Regulations 1994 gives £68.50 as the current fee and £70.00 'as at 1 August 2026', and £70.00 is kept as the fee in force (renewal £36.00). The Department of Immigration and Home Affairs' 2026 table of fees charges £250 for a first residence permit and £20 for its renewal, and £105.50 for permanent residence under the withdrawal agreement; the pages read don't say who a residence permit is for or its term, so it isn't written as a route, and nor is free movement, since the page reads a non-EU national's need for a permit only. Naturalisation as a British Overseas Territories citizen costs £580.50; its years aren't read.
